name: mirror-cartographer-five-agent-hourly-task-plan

schedule.note: The hosted workflow is on a draft PR branch and is not active on main until reviewed and merged. GitHub may delay scheduled runs.

tasks.question: Which public-safe, unresolved claim or design question is most useful to test next?
tasks.output: Claim envelope, primary-source map, counterexample or synthetic fixture, falsification route
tasks.current_execution: audit-only; does not browse or assert new findings

tasks.question: What single capability gap blocks the highest-priority research or build task?
tasks.unique_method: Compatibility, license, cost, privacy, freshness, and exit-path comparison
tasks.output: Resource decision record and implementation-ready integration criteria
tasks.current_execution: audit-only; does not search the live web or acquire resources

tasks.question: Which evidence-backed semantic or usability concept needs an editable visual expression?
tasks.unique_method: One measurable composition or interaction experiment
tasks.output: Editable SVG/CSS/tokens/interaction specification plus accessibility and provenance checks
tasks.current_execution: audit-only; creates no artwork until an authorized generation/build step is implemented

tasks.question: What is the smallest executable component that tests or improves the accepted claim?
tasks.unique_method: Local deterministic code, schema, fixture, validator, or regression test
tasks.output: Runnable artifact, exact test command, expected pass/fail conditions
tasks.current_execution: audit-only; does not modify source automatically

tasks.question: Do both repositories agree on what was observed, what is inferred, and what remains unknown?
tasks.unique_method: Cross-repository traceability, contradiction and privacy audit
tasks.output: Validation receipt, contradiction list, prioritized next action
tasks.current_execution: audit-only; cannot establish external truth or deployment health

activation_gates: Review and merge the implementation PR before the scheduled workflow is active on main
Review and merge the evidence protocol PR before treating the paired contract as the main-branch standard
Observe at least one workflow run and inspect all five receipts
Run standard-library regression tests and fix failures
Implement an authorized provider adapter before claiming external research
Implement scoped branch/PR write behavior and human-review gates before allowing automated repository updates
